if(document.documentElement.scrollWidth>window.innerWidth)throw Error('Horizontal overflow before review');var small=[...document.querySelectorAll('.sheet-manager-actions button, .sheet-manager-toolbar button')].map(b=>({label:b.getAttribute('aria-label')||b.textContent.trim(),w:Math.round(b.getBoundingClientRect().width),h:Math.round(b.getBoundingClientRect().height)})).filter(b=>b.w<44||b.h<44);if(small.length)throw Error('Small controls: '+JSON.stringify(small));'Tablet 1024x768: no horizontal overflow; '+document.querySelectorAll('.sheet-manager-actions button, .sheet-manager-toolbar button').length+' sheet-manager buttons all >= 44x44'

var review=document.querySelector('.sheet-archive-review');review.scrollIntoView({block:'center'});var rows=[...review.querySelectorAll('dl > div')].map(d=>d.querySelector('dt').textContent+'='+d.querySelector('dd').textContent);if(!rows.includes('Saved views retained=1'))throw Error('Saved views row missing: '+JSON.stringify(rows));if(document.documentElement.scrollWidth>window.innerWidth)throw Error('Horizontal overflow with review open');var buttons=[...review.querySelectorAll('button')].map(b=>{var r=b.getBoundingClientRect();return {label:b.textContent.trim(),w:Math.round(r.width),h:Math.round(r.height),visible:r.top>=0&&r.bottom<=innerHeight}});if(buttons.some(b=>b.w<44||b.h<44))throw Error('Small review buttons: '+JSON.stringify(buttons));if(!buttons.every(b=>b.visible))throw Error('Review buttons not in viewport: '+JSON.stringify(buttons));if(![...document.querySelectorAll('.sheet-manager button')].some(b=>b.textContent==='Active (13)'))throw Error('Review mutated');'Tablet review: '+JSON.stringify(rows)+'; buttons '+JSON.stringify(buttons)+'; scrollWidth '+document.documentElement.scrollWidth+' innerWidth '+innerWidth

var b=document.querySelector('[aria-label="Recover Ground floor plan"]').getBoundingClientRect();if(b.width<44||b.height<44)throw Error('Recover button small '+b.width+'x'+b.height);if(document.documentElement.scrollWidth>window.innerWidth)throw Error('Horizontal overflow in Archived list');'Tablet archived list: Recover button '+Math.round(b.width)+'x'+Math.round(b.height)

var job=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('xray:fencing-job:v2'));var doc=job.documents.find(d=>d.id===job.activeDocumentId);var key='xray.sheet-lifecycle.v1:'+JSON.stringify([job.id,doc.id,doc.sha256,doc.importedAt,doc.pageCount]);var life=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(key));var page=life.pages.find(p=>p.pageIndex===1);if(page.archived||page.name!=='Ground floor plan'||page.bookmarks.length!==1)throw Error('Tablet recover lost metadata');if(life.pages.findIndex(p=>p.pageIndex===1)!==1)throw Error('Tablet recover slot '+life.pages.findIndex(p=>p.pageIndex===1));if(document.documentElement.scrollWidth>window.innerWidth)throw Error('Horizontal overflow after recover');'Tablet recover: page 2 back in slot 1 with metadata; order '+JSON.stringify(life.pages.map(p=>p.pageIndex))
